## Description

Rank sector ETFs by trailing performance and periodically allocate to the strongest sectors.

## Where it may fit

Persistent sector leadership and broad market trends; can lag rapid rotations.

## Vehicles

Sector-rotation ETFs, tactical allocation funds, model portfolios.

## Required data

Sector ETF total-return history, distributions, liquidity, rebalance calendar and optional market filter.

## Caveats

Sector concentration and turnover can create large tracking error versus broad indexes.
